task.id: unique run identifier; retry gets a new id
task.question: original normalized question without /help prefix
task.quality: NOT_ASSESSED until an independent content review
task.sources: relative path, start/end lines, source hash, chunk id, label, excerpt
task.plan: steps with id, depends_on, check and execution status

schedules.next_run: After previous completion; no overlapping or catch-up burst
schedules.restart: Interrupted trigger is paused for owner review

chats.archive: Recoverable hide; immutable runs and reports retained

review.quality: NOT_ASSESSED; execution never implies independent semantic acceptance
review.units: Selected changed-file patch, changed HEAD lines, source snapshots and validated structured findings
review.sources: Separate FTS5 docs/code corpus; repo, exact SHA, kind, path, hash, start/end lines, chunk ID and label
review.limitations: Missing/oversized/binary/truncated/omitted diff and incomplete context remain visible
review.publication: Separate GitHub comment outcome; stale head cannot publish as current
review.notification: Separate fixed-owner delivery status/message ID; uncertainty never automatically retries
review.review_imports: Stable repository/PR/head/origin to saved task ID; no duplicate CI chat turns

task_chats.migration: Original payloads and report IDs unchanged
